'''Oriolanis Defense Systems''' was a weapons manufacturer<ref name="GFT" /> based on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Oriolanis]]. They primarily manufactured deflector systems, but they did expand their product lines to include some weapons including<ref name="NEGWT:xxv" /> [[magnetic accelerator]]s, the [[Striker projectile pistol]],<ref name="EGWT" /> and the [[Blaster Buster]].<ref name="GFT" />
